thesis: The podcast argues that because ten stocks in the US and global fixed income markets are heavily leveraged to the same trend, investors seeking diversification must look to private markets where exposure to major companies like OpenAI and SpaceX is currently near zero. It further asserts that the convergence of AI, robotics, energy infrastructure, and data centers is creating enormous new capital demands, forcing finance and technology to converge in ways that barely existed a decade ago.
